title: 3D geometry and materials
summary: Construct 3D geometry, load models and configure materials and lighting for the desired surface.

blocks.text: Model wraps triangle geometry with a fragment component and renderer. Box, Sphere, Cylinder, Cone, Torus and Plane supply mesh generators. Model constructors accept a WebGPUMesh, CPU positions/indices/UVs, or GPU vertex and index buffers. Smooth versus flat topology controls normal treatment.

Material contains base color, emissive color/strength, roughness, metallic, transmission, index of refraction and opacity. Paint belongs to vector styling; changing paint.fill does not substitute for material.color in every 3D pipeline. Transmission and glass appearance depend on the renderer, denoiser, lighting and ray-trace enable flags.

PBR models use material and scene lighting. ManimSurfaceFragment provides an illustration-oriented surface with view-oriented normals and optional checkerboard treatment. Model.useManimShading and usePBRShading change the fragment path; RenderConfig.shadingStyle controls PBR/Gooch/Cel/Clay choices in supported pipelines.

OBJLoader parses Wavefront OBJ/MTL into meshes and material information. Check material names, texture URLs, winding, UVs and normal behavior on a small model before importing a large asset. Model.setVertices/setMesh replace geometry; updateVertices updates compatible positions and normals. Reusing topology avoids unnecessary buffer and pipeline churn.

Terrain3D accepts height data and procedural generation options. ParametricModel samples a function over normalized parameter coordinates and accepts Vec3 output; its current constructor takes the function and an options object, not u/v range tuples. ParametricSurface3D exposes a separate coordinate-system-based plotting contract. Choose the class that matches whether the surface is standalone geometry or a mathematical plot.
